description: This file defines the `MenuHostedItem` struct, which conforms to `NSViewRepresentable`, allowing SwiftUI views to be hosted within AppKit menu items by wrapping them in an `NSHostingView`. It manages sizing and updates for embedding SwiftUI content in native macOS menu components.

methods.name: makeNSView
methods.description: Creates and returns an `NSHostingView` initialized with the provided `rootView`, then applies sizing constraints.

methods.name: updateNSView
methods.description: Updates the root view of an existing `NSHostingView` and reapplies sizing constraints.

methods.name: applySizing
methods.description: Adjusts the frame size of the hosting view based on specified width and its fitting size.
